a4_contract.interpretation: A4 is the closed directed availability matrix over source text, typed syntax, canonical and legacy bridge envelopes, logic-family representations, prover syntax, controlled natural language, and proof/tactic/counterexample/translation traces. No separate A4 JSON Schema exists in the frozen source, so this document makes the row and evidence rules explicit.
a4_contract.row_rule: Every row has explicit source and target schemas, deterministic and learned implementation cells, examples, proof/counterexample/round-trip coverage, token/cosine/syntax/type/proof metric cells, limitations, evidence, and remediation references.
a4_contract.evidence_rule: Every non-unknown status cell has at least one evidence_ref. Each evidence_ref resolves through evidence_catalog to repository paths, receipt identities, or both. Unknown cells retain null values and are never converted to zero.
a4_contract.metric_rule: A declared field, default value, unit test, provider discovery result, or route availability is not a measured metric. Numeric values appear only when a cited receipt reports that exact value and population.
a4_contract.authority_rule: Compilation, decompilation, translation, model output, solver output, and orchestration never increase semantic or proof authority. Only independently accepted evidence bound to exact inputs can do so.
a4_contract.sorting: Direction rows are ordered by required_direction_classes and then direction_id; IDs and evidence paths are unique within their owning collections.

E-PGIR003.scope: Supervisor provider, tactician, hammer, prover, checker, and authority-boundary inventory.

E-PGIR004.scope: Twenty-one exact JusticeDAO release pins, 7,173 inventory candidate source rows, and zero training-admitted rows.

E-CANONICAL-CONTRACT.scope: CanonicalRoundTripIR@1, O/P/F seven-facet rule grammar, request/result contracts, source maps, unsupported semantics, and component traces.

E-CANONICAL-COMPILER.scope: Current deterministic source-to-canonical compiler; caller vocabulary, explicit partial handling, no learned stages, and no fallback.

E-CANONICAL-DECOMPILER.scope: Current stateless source-withheld deterministic controlled-text realizer.

E-CANONICAL-ROUNDTRIP.scope: Five-case historical canonical compile/decompile/recompile snapshot; its compiler byte identity is stale under PGIR-005.

E-REPLACEMENT-MATRIX.scope: Historical deterministic and model-backed candidate matrix; only two deterministic typed-deontic arms were eligible, the result was an exact tie, and the report allowed no production promotion.

E-DEONTIC.scope: Family-specific LegalNormIR parser, controlled decoder, source grounding, formula records, and prover-syntax generation.

E-FORMALIZATION.scope: Domain-neutral artifact/view declarations and deterministic Legal, Security, and Intent adapters; declarations do not provide a domain-neutral inverse.

E-BRIDGE.scope: LegalIRDocument/LogicIRView envelope, six registered adapters, metric field declarations, proof gates, and unresolved repository-wide typed bridge.

E-TDFOL.scope: TDFOL AST/parser/prover, TDFOL-DCEC and FOL/TPTP conversions, and countermodels; preservation is not repository-wide authority.

E-DCEC.scope: Distinct DCEC-family AST and prover contracts.

E-HAMMER.scope: Typed first-order lowering, emitted-subset SMT-LIB/TPTP codecs, explicit unsupported translation, candidate/reconstruction records, and kernel-check trust boundary.

E-INTENT.scope: Intent typed declarations, formalization, and review-oriented structural decompilation; exact text regeneration is explicitly not claimed.

E-MODAL.scope: Parallel ModalIR family compiler and source-bearing reconstruction, distinct from the source-withheld canonical decompiler.

E-SUPERVISOR-TACTIC.scope: Tactic proposal and orchestration with no independent proof authority.

historical_measurements.qualification_blocker: PGIR-005 observed that the checked-in compiler raw CID differs from the live compiler bytes; these values remain historical and are not current-input metrics.

GAP-SEMANTIC-CID-DRIFT.finding: The checked-in canonical parity snapshot is not bound to the live compiler bytes.
GAP-SEMANTIC-CID-DRIFT.remediation: Execute the sealed PGIR-005 semantic_cid_drift repair proposal under a separate revision, regenerate only from the admitted implementation, and rerun canonical parity without weakening the exact-CID gate.

GAP-CANONICAL-BRIDGE.finding: CanonicalRoundTripIR, FormalizationArtifact, and LegalIRDocument have parallel meanings and no single rich repository-wide typed bridge.
GAP-CANONICAL-BRIDGE.remediation: PGIR-020 must compose one versioned bridge from existing contracts, retain family identity, source references, assumptions, provenance, and explicit unsupported constructs, and provide migrations and family conformance vectors.

GAP-DOMAIN-LOGIC-SLICE.finding: No DomainLogicSlice schema or implementation exists at the bound authority tree.
GAP-DOMAIN-LOGIC-SLICE.remediation: PGIR-020 must represent the required slice behavior inside the consolidated bridge or explicitly retain it as unsupported; it must not introduce a new logic family or silently alias an existing family AST.

GAP-DOMAIN-NEUTRAL-DECOMPILER.finding: There is no domain-neutral inverse of FormalizationCompiler; existing decoders have intentionally different reconstruction guarantees.
GAP-DOMAIN-NEUTRAL-DECOMPILER.remediation: PGIR-022 must separate controlled semantic reconstruction, structural review, and style paraphrase, and require recompilation plus semantic comparison before claiming fidelity.

GAP-TRANSLATION-PRESERVATION.finding: Family and prover codecs exist, but preservation classes are not uniformly closed, receipted, and measured in both directions.
GAP-TRANSLATION-PRESERVATION.remediation: PGIR-022 must attach one of lossless, equisatisfiable, over-approximation, under-approximation, heuristic, or unsupported to each translation and validate semantic differences adversarially.

GAP-METRIC-BASELINE.finding: Token, cosine, syntax, type, and proof metrics are absent, definition-only, historical, or blocked for most directions; missing values cannot be interpreted as zero.
GAP-METRIC-BASELINE.remediation: PGIR-023 must report compiler and decompiler metrics separately with denominators, family/domain strata, unsupported and unknown outcomes, exact trace CIDs, and independent proof replay where available.

GAP-LEARNED-ADMISSION.finding: Learned compiler, decompiler, embedding, and tactic candidates exist, but no model-backed direction is current semantic or proof authority and the legacy checkpoint is artifact-only.
GAP-LEARNED-ADMISSION.remediation: PGIR-030 and descendants must freeze compatible architecture, tokenizer, checkpoint, loss, lineage, and evaluation identities; model outputs remain candidates until deterministic gates admit them.

GAP-PROOF-ENVIRONMENT.finding: The proof route inventory is available or degraded by provider, but current qualification lacks the Hammer environment lock and the Lean runtime package export.
GAP-PROOF-ENVIRONMENT.remediation: Execute the two sealed PGIR-005 repair proposals under separate task revisions, retain unavailable states, and rerun proof/reconstruction evidence without treating discovery as proof.

GAP-QUALIFIED-EXAMPLES.finding: PGIR-004 identifies 7,173 source candidates but admits zero rows for training; current direction examples are fixtures only.
GAP-QUALIFIED-EXAMPLES.remediation: PGIR-010 through PGIR-012 must establish source, rights, lineage, and leakage-safe split contracts before any inventory row is used for training or evaluation.

GAP-TRACE-REPLAY.finding: Trace schemas are family- and workflow-specific, and no closed record binds every compiler, decompiler, translation, proof, tactic, counterexample, and round-trip example with one authority vocabulary.
GAP-TRACE-REPLAY.remediation: PGIR-013 must add versioned admissible trace/example contracts and exact proof-to-statement binding; PGIR-021 through PGIR-023 must emit replayable stage identities and equality criteria.

human_summary.headline: A narrow deterministic Legal text to canonical IR to controlled-text cycle exists, while the repository-wide typed bridge, DomainLogicSlice, domain-neutral inverse, qualified proof environment, and current per-direction metrics remain gaps.
findings: COMPILER-CURRENT-1 and DECOMPILER-CURRENT-1 are deterministic, source-withheld at the reverse boundary, and contain no learned stage, but their canonical grammar covers only seven O/P/F rule facets and requires caller-supplied atoms.

CanonicalRoundTripIR, FormalizationArtifact, LegalIRDocument, TDFOL, DCEC, Intent, Security, and ModalIR remain distinct meanings. Existing adapters are reusable components, not evidence that one repository-wide bridge already exists.
TDFOL/DCEC converters and Hammer SMT-LIB/TPTP codecs provide useful deterministic paths, but structural round-trip tests do not establish a declared semantic-preservation class.

Controlled reconstruction is family-specific: the canonical path emits fixed source-withheld prose, Deontic emits slot-grounded prose, Modal carries source-bearing reconstruction, and Intent emits semantic review rather than prose.
Proof, tactic, counterexample, and translation trace contracts exist, but current proof qualification is blocked and no general trace-to-semantic inverse exists.
The only numeric semantic observations carried here are the five-case historical canonical losses. Token, cosine, syntax, type, and proof values remain null wherever no exact current receipt exists.
JusticeDAO pins provide 7,173 inventory candidate source rows but zero training-admitted rows; fixture availability must not be confused with a qualified corpus.
next_actions_in_order: Repair the exact semantic implementation CID and proof-environment prerequisites under their sealed separate revisions.
Use PGIR-020 to consolidate the typed bridge and explicitly resolve or preserve the DomainLogicSlice absence.
Use PGIR-021 and PGIR-022 to make compiler stages replayable and translation/reconstruction guarantees explicit.
Use PGIR-023 to measure every required metric with denominators and unknown/unsupported strata before learned training or promotion.

explicit_nonclaims: Availability is not semantic preservation, proof, training admission, or production promotion.
A passing unit or integration test without a reported denominator is not converted into a numeric metric.
RoundTripMetrics defaults and registered loss names are not observed zero values.
The five-case canonical snapshot is historical because PGIR-005 found compiler CID drift; this matrix does not refresh or reinterpret it.
Solver success, model output, tactic selection, and provider discovery remain candidates or orchestration until an independent authority accepts exact bound evidence.
No DomainLogicSlice, repository-wide Formula alias, domain-neutral formalization decompiler, fixed composite loss, unified semantic checkpoint, or qualified publication authority is invented.
The 7,173 source candidates are not training rows, proof of completeness, or legal authorization.
